description: This is a C header file defining interfaces related to JSON handling, including function prototypes for reading/writing JSON data and file operations, guarded by a conditional compilation macro.

methods.name: readFromFile
methods.description: Reads content from a specified file path into a string

methods.name: getArrayNode
methods.description: Retrieves an array node from a cJSON object

methods.name: saveToFile
methods.description: Saves a JSON array node to a file with a given format and name

methods.name: saveIfNodeContainsLists
methods.description: Saves a JSON node to a specified path if it contains lists

methods.name: iterateAndSaveArrayNodes
methods.description: Iterates over JSON data and saves array nodes to files

methods.name: getFilePath
methods.description: Retrieves the file path used in JSON operations
